meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让应用接入微信个人号,扫码登录后即可收发私聊消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让自己的应用或机器人接上微信个人号收发消息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your app or bot to send and receive messages on a personal WeChat account

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加一条个人微信通道:用腾讯官方 iLink Bot API 长轮询收发消息,扫码登录,不用 webhook、不用付费 token。装好后还要把某个微信会话接到 agent group,它才会回复。
howto.when: 当你想把个人微信(非企业微信/公众号)接入 NanoClaw 时使用;安装后重启服务,日志或 data/wechat/qr.txt 会打印二维码 URL,用手机微信扫码授权。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制微信适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试。

say.text: 微信登录二维码在哪?帮我看下日志
say.note: 会打印二维码 URL 供手机扫码。

say.text: 把这个微信会话接到我的 agent group

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw via Tencent's official iLink Bot API: long-poll send/receive, QR login, no webhook and no paid token. You still must wire a WeChat chat to an agent group before it replies.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to connect a personal WeChat account (not WeCom or Official Account) to NanoClaw. After install, restart; a QR URL is printed to the logs or data/wechat/qr.txt.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs the test.

say_en.text: Where's the WeChat QR login code?
say_en.note: Prints the QR URL from logs or data/wechat/qr.txt.

say_en.text: Wire this WeChat chat to my agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to pick an agent group.
